quests.name: Twisted Evils
quests.summary: Collect 25 Theradric Crystal Carvings for Willow in Desolace.

quests.name: Vyletongue Corruption
quests.summary: Fill the Coated Cerulean Vial at the orange crystal pool in Maraudon.Use the Filled Cerulean Vial on the Vylestem Vines to force the corrupted Noxxious Scion to emerge.Heal 8 plants by killing these Noxxious Scion, then return to Vark Battlescar in Shadowprey Village.

quests.name: The Pariah's Instructions
quests.summary: Read the Pariah's Instructions. Afterwards, obtain the Amulet of Union from Maraudon and return it to the Centaur Pariah in southern Desolace.

quests.name: Legends of Maraudon
quests.summary: Recover the two parts of the Scepter of Celebras: the Celebrian Rod and the Celebrian Diamond.Find a way to speak with Celebras. A quest from Classic World of Warcraft.

quests.name: The Scepter of Celebras
quests.summary: Assist Celebras the Redeemed while he creates the Scepter of Celebras.Speak with him when the ritual is complete.

quests.name: Corruption of Earth and Seed

quests.name: Seed of Life
quests.summary: Seek out Remulos in Moonglade and give him the Seed of Life.
